name: Jotun, Frost
body:
FROST JOTUN
CR 12/MR 4

This towering humanoid stands over 20 feet high, with pale blue skin and long, light-colored hair done up in intricate braids. It wears a massive shirt of mail and hefts a mighty axe, and as it walks wisps of chill mist trail behind it as ice fills its footsteps.

XP 19,200
CE Huge humanoid (cold, giant, mythic)
Init –2; Senses low-light vision, snow vision; Perception +10 (+20 in snowy or icy terrain)
Aura numbing sleet (10 ft., DC 24)

DEFENSE

AC 27, touch 6, flat-footed 27 (+5 armor, –2 Dex, +16 natural, –2 size)
hp 193 (14d8+130)
Fort +16, Ref +2, Will +6
Defensive Abilities rock catching; DR 10/epic; Immune cold
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee +1 greataxe +22/+17 (3d8+20 plus 4d6 cold) or 2 slams +21 (2d6+13 plus 4d6 cold)
Ranged rock +7 (2d6+19 plus 4d6 cold)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks ground breaker, mythic power (4/day, surge +1d8), rime weapons, rock throwing (120 ft.)

STATISTICS

Str 37, Dex 7, Con 24, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 11
Base Atk +10; CMB +25 (+27 overrun and sunder); CMD 33 (35 vs. overrun and sunder)
Feats Cleave, Great Cleave, Improved Overrun, Improved Sunder, Martial Weapon Proficiency (greataxe), Power Attack, Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Climb +17, Craft (any one) +7, Intimidate +7, Perception +10, Stealth +2 (+6 in snow); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in snow
Languages Common, Giant
SQ icewalker

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Ground Breaker (Ex)

A frost jotun can expend one use of mythic power and attack the ground around him, striking one intersection within reach. Creatures touching the ground within 20 feet of that intersection take 6d8+40 points of bludgeoning damage (DC 30 Reflex half), and those failing their save fall prone. All of the squares adjacent to the intersection become dense rubble, each square surrounding that area light rubble. The save DC is Strength-based.

Icewalker (Ex)

A frost jotun can move across icy and snowy surfaces without difficulty and does not need to make Acrobatics checks to run or charge on ice.

Numbing Sleet (Su)

Creatures not immune to cold that begin their turn in the jotun’s aura is staggered for 1 round (Fortitude DC 24 negates). The sleet extinguishes torches and small fires, provides the giant with concealment against creatures outside the aura. The sleet also causes the ground in the area to become icy and remain icy for 1 minute after the frost jotun passes. A creature can walk within or through the giant’s aura at half normal speed with a DC 10 Acrobatics check. Failure means it can’t move in that round, while failure by 5 or more means it falls prone (see the Acrobatics skill for details). The save DC is Constitution-based.

Rime Weapons (Su)

All melee and ranged attacks made by the frost jotun deal an additional 4d6 points of cold damage.

Snow Vision (Ex)

A frost jotun can see perfectly in snow, sleet, fog, and mist. It gains a +10 circumstance bonus on Perception checks to spot creatures in snowy or icy terrain.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold mountains
Organization solitary, gang (1 frost jotun and 3–5 frost giants), band (1 frost jotun and 6–12 frost giants plus 35% noncombatants and 1 frost jotun adept or cleric of 1st–2nd level), raiding party (6–12 frost giants plus 35% noncombatants, 1 frost jotun adept or sorcerer of 3rd–5th level, 1–4 winter wolves, and 2–3 ogres), or tribe (2-3 frost jotuns, 21–30 frost giants plus 1 frost giant adept, cleric, or sorcerer of 6th–7th level; 1 frost jotun barbarian or ranger jarl of 7th–9th level; and 15–36 winter wolves, 13–22 ogres, and 1–2 young white dragons)
Treasure standard (+1 shadow chain shirt, +1 greataxe, other treasure)

Frost jotuns are the titanic champions of giant clans of the polar reaches and snowy mountains. Their lesser kin generally revere them as something nearly divine, and the jotuns do little to dissuade them, recruiting adepts and priests to venerate them as representatives of the true giant gods. Normally an unruly lot, most frost giants readily submit to a jotun’s power and authority, if only for fear of their mighty wrath. Some frost jotuns are loners, preferring to hunt the algid wilds alone or with their favored hunting beasts, but most prefer the life of a mountain king, building an army of giantish servants in their frozen fortresses and sending them ranging into the warmer lands in search of plunder. Frost jotuns are typically 20 to 25 feet tall and weigh 3 tons or more.
